name: as-any
description: `as any` erases the type checker at that expression — on money and multi-tenant paths that's where a mispriced charge or a cross-org data leak hides. `(req as any)` and `(req.user as any).id`-style casts have typed replacements (AuthenticatedRequest + req.user.id, getOrganizationId(req)); Express-internals monkey-patches are the residual baseline. This ratchet freezes the count and drives it strictly DOWN — lower baselineCount whenever a reduction lands.
lastBumpNote: 1433 -> 1429 on 2026-07-29: Wave B ('Wire the engine') cleanup. The wave's 7 new casts were TYPED rather than baselined — leads.deletedAt/organizationId read straight off the Lead row (organizationId is notNull, so the old `as number | undefined` was actively lying about a multi-tenant key), the CSV-import drizzle insert and the workflow_delay_resume claim-update payloads type-check as-is, isWithinQuietHoursForLead accepts a Lead unchanged, and the two contactFrequency boundaries were narrowed to precise shapes (`Record<string, unknown>` for the organizations.settings jsonb blob; `Date | string | null` for the driver-dependent timestamp) per the routes-rent-ledger.ts precedent. Fixing the underlying types also cleared 3 pre-existing casts of the same shape in sequenceProcessor.ts. Locked in per this ratchet's strictly-down rule.
